question: \(f(x)=-x\). When \(x_2-x_1=2\), what is \(f(x_2)-f(x_1)\)?
solution: \(f(x_2)-f(x_1)=-(x_2-x_1)=-2\). The difference is negative, indicating that the function is decreasing.
